observations: 2014 West Indian Medical Journal study: retrospective cross-sectional review of 83 patients and 150 erupted third-molar extractions at Autonomous University of Hidalgo State clinics in Mexico.
Reported extraction indications: prosthetic 44.0%, orthodontic 24.7%, dental caries 20.0%, periodontal disease 11.3%.
